about_the_game:
Welcome to the most atmospheric bar in the galaxy - Prometheus-9, hidden among the forgotten stars of a distant sector.

You are the bartender and owner of this cosmic hideout, where the fates of drifters, bounty hunters, lovers, fugitives, and mysterious alien beings intertwine — some so rare, even Central Command has never heard of them.

Craft custom cocktails by mixing exotic ingredients from across the galaxy, and see how each drink affects your guests’ moods, honesty, and even life decisions. After all, every visitor comes not just for a drink, but with a story to tell — and a problem that maybe, just maybe, you can help solve.

Immerse yourself in deep conversations where every choice can alter the course of events. Build relationships with key characters — including women from different worlds and species — and see them evolve from casual flirting to meaningful romances where emotions outweigh the distance between stars.

Upgrade your bar, unlock new recipes, decorate your space with unique items, and grow Prometheus-9 into a sanctuary for the galaxy’s most unusual and unforgettable souls.

Game Features:

✨ An atmospheric visual novel set in the far reaches of space
❤️ 6 unique ladies from across the galaxy to bond and build relationships with
✨ 4 side characters you can get very close to
❤️ A unique cocktail-making mechanic using exotic ingredients
✨ Non-linear storylines with multiple paths and outcomes
❤️ Bar development and customization — buy new ingredients and decorate your interior

content_descriptors.notes:
All participants are of legal age and express their consent. 
It contains sexual acts, nudity, scenes of BDSM, sex with foreign objects, group sex.
The game contains scenes of sex while intoxicated, but does not focus on it.
Most of the drinks in the game are not "alcoholic".
The game does not mention any known types of alcoholic beverages, with the exception of beer.
